regions.merged_text: Many thanks for your kind favor of the 27th. God bless you too Maurice O'Connell. I hope this finds you improved and improving. However, I think you would do well to see a good Chiropractor. I was doctoring for at least three years for my feet and legs - using a cain for several months and quite lame. ..... .. In less than three week Dr. Ralph Schorn had me on my feet - with my cain a forgotten thing. His of- fice is just across Gratiot Ave. from the Airport - 10050 Connors Ave. Hoping this finds you 100% in God's grace and service.
